1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.FacetLabels
2 
3 /-! Original edge incidence transferred to finite sets of original vertex labels. -/
4 
5 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
6 
7 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (index : Fin 6 ≃ P.Vertex)
8 
9 /-- All original facets, recorded by their sets of original vertex labels. -/
10 noncomputable def labeledFacets : Finset (Finset (Fin 6)) :=
11   (Set.range (fun F : P.Face => F.vertexLabels index)).toFinite.toFinset
12 
13 @[simp] theorem mem_labeledFacets (vertices : Finset (Fin 6)) :
14     vertices ∈ labeledFacets index ↔ ∃ F : P.Face, F.vertexLabels index = vertices := by
15   simp [labeledFacets]
16 
17 /-- An original edge occurs in exactly two of the labeled original facets. -/
18 theorem labeledFacets_edge_count (i j : Fin 6) (edge : P.edgeGraph.Adj (index i) (index j)) :
19     ((labeledFacets index).filter (fun face => i ∈ face ∧ j ∈ face)).card = 2 := by
20   classical
21   obtain ⟨F, G, different, iF, jF, iG, jG, only_two⟩ := P.edge_incident_faces (index i) (index j) edge
22   have pair : (labeledFacets index).filter (fun face => i ∈ face ∧ j ∈ face) =
23       {F.vertexLabels index, G.vertexLabels index} := by
24     ext vertices
25     simp only [Finset.mem_filter, mem_labeledFacets, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
26     constructor
27     · rintro ⟨⟨H, rfl⟩, hi, hj⟩
28       rcases only_two H ((H.mem_vertexLabels index i).mp hi) ((H.mem_vertexLabels index j).mp hj) with rfl | rfl
29       exacts [Or.inl rfl, Or.inr rfl]
30     · rintro (rfl | rfl)
31       · exact ⟨⟨F, rfl⟩, (F.mem_vertexLabels index i).mpr iF, (F.mem_vertexLabels index j).mpr jF⟩
32       · exact ⟨⟨G, rfl⟩, (G.mem_vertexLabels index i).mpr iG, (G.mem_vertexLabels index j).mpr jG⟩
33   rw [pair, Finset.card_pair]
34   exact (Face.vertexLabels_injective index).ne different
35 
36 /-- A distinct nonedge pair occurs together in at most one labeled original facet. -/
37 theorem labeledFacets_nonedge_count (i j : Fin 6) (different : i ≠ j)
38     (nonedge : ¬ P.edgeGraph.Adj (index i) (index j)) :
39     ((labeledFacets index).filter (fun face => i ∈ face ∧ j ∈ face)).card ≤ 1 := by
40   classical
41   apply Finset.card_le_one.mpr
42   intro left left_mem right right_mem
43   obtain ⟨left_mem, il, jl⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp left_mem
44   obtain ⟨right_mem, ir, jr⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp right_mem
45   obtain ⟨F, rfl⟩ := (mem_labeledFacets index left).mp left_mem
46   obtain ⟨G, rfl⟩ := (mem_labeledFacets index right).mp right_mem
47   rw [Face.eq_of_common_nonedge_labels index F G i j different nonedge il jl ir jr]
48 
49 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
